title: Empty-set Fourier coefficient is the mean
statement:
Let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ be a Boolean function. Then its Fourier–Walsh coefficient at the empty frequency equals its expectation under the uniform measure:
\[
  \hat f(\varnothing) \;=\; \E[f].
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on the n-dimensional cube
